goal: Real Architect + Coder + Reviewer collaboration: Claude as architect drafts spec, Codex as coder implements, Claude as reviewer accepts or revises.
intent_override: Build a normalize-and-casefold text helper that accepts UTF-8 bytes, NFC-normalizes, then casefolds. Reject non-UTF-8 with a structured error.
expected_flow: Review pass by Reviewer (Claude) reads diff + verify summary -> accept | revise
If accept -> done. If revise -> Coder takes another pass with concerns surfaced
success_criteria: All three real CLI invocations show in transcripts
At least one Review turn renders 'accept' (not stuck at revise)
Coder's second pass (if any) shows concerns from Reviewer in handoff prompt
